meta.name: to-tickets
meta.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker (edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解方案或讨论为带依赖的任务单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常把方案或讨论纪要变成任务清单
copy.tagline_en: Turn plans and specs into dependency-aware tickets automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn plans or specs into actionable task lists.

howto.what: 把用户给出的计划、规格或当前对话拆成一组垂直切片式tickets:每张票描述它要跑通的端到端行为,并注明被哪些票阻塞;先列出草稿征求确认,再发布到配置好的追踪器(本地每票一文件或真实issue系统的原生阻塞链接)。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求把计划、规格或当前对话拆成带依赖关系的tickets,或要求把拆好的票据发布到配置的追踪器时。

say.text: 把这份计划拆成 tickets,先给我确认再发布。
say.note: 会先给出按依赖排序的草稿,待你批准。

say.text: 把当前对话的待办拆成垂直切片 tickets,先出草稿别发布。
say.note: 只生成草稿供你检查,不写任何文件。

howto.what_en: Breaks a plan, spec, or current conversation into tracer-bullet tickets: each declares its end-to-end behaviour and blocking edges, is reviewed by you, then published to the configured tracker (local files or native blocking links).
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks to break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into such tickets, or asks to publish the tickets to the configured tracker.

say_en.text: Turn this plan into tickets and show me the breakdown before publishing.
say_en.note: A dependency-ordered draft is presented first.

say_en.text: Turn the pending items from this conversation into vertical tickets as a draft only.
Publish these tickets to GitHub and label them ready-for-agent.
say_en.note: Creates one issue per ticket in dependency order.
